description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class that demonstrates the use of SwipeRefreshLayout to implement swipe-to-refresh functionality in an Android app. It manages a ListView with refresh capabilities triggered by swipe gestures or menu actions, including background data refresh simulation.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshLayoutBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating swipe-to-refresh with a ListView, including menu refresh option and simulated background data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and enables options menu.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, retrieves SwipeRefreshLayout and ListView, and sets color scheme.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up ListView adapter and refresh listener for swipe gestures.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to trigger refresh.

methods.name: initiateRefresh
methods.description: Starts background task to refresh data.

methods.name: onRefreshComplete
methods.description: Updates ListView with new data and stops refresh indicator.
